description_en: Queries the disaster recovery drills that were performed on the replication pair-consistent group whose secondary disk resides in a specific region
description_zh: 该接口用于查询当前地域的盘作为复制组从端时，曾经对复制组所启动的容灾演练
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-replica-group-drills --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id pg-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeReplicaGroupDrills

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the primary or secondary disk in the async replication pair-consistent group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html operation to query the most recent list of regions in which async replication is supported
parameters.help_zh: 异步复制组中主盘或从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html operation to query a list of async replication pair-consistent groups, including group IDs
parameters.help_zh: 复制组ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html接口查询异步复制组列表，获得复制组ID入参的值
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken. When you specify NextToken, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters do not take effect and the TotalCount response parameter is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to be returned. You can use this parameter together with NextToken.

Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
本次调用期望查询的最大条目数。可配合NextToken参数一起使用。

取值范围：1~500。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围1-100
parameters.name: page_size

Drills.description_en: The information of disaster recovery drills that were performed on the replication pair-consistent group
Drills.description_zh: 复制组容灾演练的信息组成的集合

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group

DrillDiskId.description_en: The ID of the drill disk

DrillDiskStatus.description_en:
The status of the drill disk. Valid values:

created
deleted
creating
deleting

This parameter can also display error code details if your drill disk fails to be created or deleted
DrillDiskStatus.description_zh:
演练盘状态。可能值：
created：已创建。
deleted：已删除。
creating：创建中。
deleting：删除中。

除演练盘状态外，还可以展示演练盘创建或删除失败的错误码详情

PairId.description_en: The ID of the replication pair

RecoverPoint.description_en: The recovery point of the drill. The value of this parameter is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
RecoverPoint.description_zh: 该演练对应的恢复点。该参数以时间戳的形式提供返回值。单位：秒

StartAt.description_en: The beginning time of the drill. The value of this parameter is a timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartAt.description_zh: 演练启动时间。该参数以时间戳的形式提供返回值。单位：秒
StartAt.title_en: 演练启动时间。该参数以时间戳的形式提供返回值。单位：秒。
StartAt.title_zh: 演练启动时间。该参数以时间戳的形式提供返回值。单位：秒。

Status.description_en:
The status of the drill. Valid values:

execute_failed
executed
executing
clear_failed
clearing
Status.description_zh:
演练状态。可能值：
execute_failed：执行失败。
executed：已执行。
executing：执行中。
clear_failed：清理失败。
clearing：清理中

StatusMessage.description_en: The error message that appears if the drill fails to be executed
StatusMessage.description_zh: 任务执行失败的错误提示信息
StatusMessage.title_en: 任务执行失败的错误提示信息。
StatusMessage.title_zh: 任务执行失败的错误提示信息。

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）
NextToken.title_en: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
NextToken.title_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。

PageNumber.title_en: 分页模式查询时的页数。
PageNumber.title_zh: 分页模式查询时的页数。

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
PageSize.title_en: 分页模式查询时的单页记录数量。
PageSize.title_zh: 分页模式查询时的单页记录数量。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 分页查询时的结果总条数
